For the author of rattanakosin-kingdom (se-01-j): add a 1792 gain of Tavoy and Mergui from konbaung-dynasty and move the 1793 loss of the Tenasserim coast to January 1794 (Burmese-Siamese War 1792-1794 page: Battle of Tavoy, assault of 16 January 1794, no cession described); its 1885-1898 keyframes should drop the Chiang Mai cells (chiangmai runs to December 1899).

For the author of ayutthaya-kingdom (se-01-e): konbaung-dynasty now records a gain from ayutthaya-kingdom in April 1767 and a loss to thonburi-kingdom in November 1767 (the occupation was removed); ayutthaya-kingdom has a dissolve in April 1767 with counterpart thonburi-kingdom but no loss to konbaung-dynasty, and no 1763 regain of Tavoy.

konbaung-dynasty and burma are one state split at a Cliopatria row boundary (1819/1820); they now agree on the farther Shan states and northern Kachin (tributary) but konbaung keeps the nearer 65 per cent of Shan State as direct land while burma tints all of it: settle in the orchestrator (one colour and family; one status for Shan State).

New keyframes added in the repair: tay-son-dynasty_1786, konbaung-dynasty_1767, _1792 and _1804; the Lampang and Lamphun cells of Thonburi's shape are now in Konbaung's 1763-1774 keyframes and in thonburi-kingdom's 1775 gain, and Konbaung's 1775 loss is split between chiangmai and thonburi-kingdom.
